🔥 PageLM | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To convert static study materials into dynamic, interactive learning tools using AI, making studying more engaging and effective.
✨ Key Features: • AI-powered transformation of study materials • Generates quizzes, flashcards, notes, and podcasts • Community-driven open-source project • Inspired by NotebookLM • Built with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and LangChain
📖 Summary: PageLM is an open-source AI-powered education platform that transforms study materials like PDFs and lecture notes into interactive learning resources. It aims to provide a community-driven alternative to tools like NotebookLM, offering features such as quizzes, flashcards, notes, and podcasts.
